Hi Chris / Asha,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the thorough run-through of FinHealth's requirements. Below is a short recap from our side to make sure we captured the key pain points and next steps. Please flag anything we missed or misinterpreted.

1) Pain points / primary requirements
- Regulated workloads: PHI-sensitive inference workloads cannot leave customer-controlled network boundaries.
- Network constraints: Must keep traffic on a private connection (Direct Connect or VPN) and avoid egress through public internet.
- Key management: Customer-managed KMS/HSM for model input/output encryption and auditability.
- Air-gap / on-prem consideration: Some fleets may require an on-prem or air-gapped option for certain environments.

2) Current stack (what we heard)
- Production services hosted in AWS in a dedicated VPC; EKS + private subnets; SSO via Okta; centralized KMS (AWS KMS) for data-at-rest keys.
- CI/CD pipelines deploy to private clusters; strict egress rules enforced by network team.

3) Success criteria for POC
- Demonstrate private connectivity (Direct Connect) with traffic not transiting the public internet.
- Integrate Redwood Private with customer-managed KMS/HSM.
- Meet FinHealth security questionnaire baseline (SOC2, audit logs, retention controls).
- Maintain latency targets for inference (< 200ms P95 for common request sizes).

4) Proposed next steps
- Marissa / Redwood: share private VPC checklist and our standard security questionnaire (attached).
- FinHealth: share network diagram and specific firewall rules we need to accommodate (ACM / NACL details).
- Schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive with your infra/network & security teams (Dylan from Redwood to lead).

Attachments: redwood-private-vpc-checklist.pdf

If that aligns, I can send a calendar invite for the technical deep-dive next week — suggested times Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Chris / Asha — Dylan here (Solutions Engineer). Quick follow-ups ahead of the deep-dive so we can tailor the session and bring the right artifacts: 

1) Network connectivity
- Preferred private connectivity: do you have an existing Direct Connect or will we use a site-to-site VPN? If Direct Connect, can you share the VLAN/AS info and if you require BGP peering?
- Firewall: please confirm which outbound ports we can use for the Redwood control plane (if any). For the Private deployment we typically use a small set of egress ports to our control plane for updates/telemetry; some customers prefer a fully air-gapped control plane — we can cover both approaches.

2) KMS/HSM
- CloudHSM: we support integration patterns that use envelope encryption where the master key is in your HSM and Redwood holds wrapped keys. Can you confirm whether FinHealth requires zero-knowledge key escrow or full split-key models?

3) Audit logging and retention
- We can retain and stream inference logs to your S3 bucket with server-side encryption using your KMS key and configure immutability/lifecycle for 12 months. Does FinHealth have specific hashing/integrity algorithms required for logs?

4) POC scope & success metrics
- We propose a 4-week POC with these acceptance criteria: private connectivity established, KMS integration validated with example inference workloads, and P95 latency within agreed target. Any other measurable goals you want to add?

Attachments: none in this note — I'll bring architecture diagrams and examples to the call.

Suggested times for the 60-min deep-dive: Wed 2026-11-18 10:00 PT (confirmed), Thu 2026-11-19 13:00 PT.

Looking forward to it — if you can share the network peering details and any specific KMS/HSM policies beforehand that would speed up the session.
